facts.text: The Sky Residences at W Aspen is located at the base of Aspen Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Located at the base of the world-renowned Aspen Mountain, The Sky Residences at W Aspen is the first and only W Hotels Alpine Escape in North America.

facts.text: The Sky Residences at W Aspen is the first and only W Hotels Alpine Escape in North America.
facts.excerpt: The Sky Residences at W Aspen is the first and only W Hotels Alpine Escape in North America

facts.text: The property offers mountainside access to the slopes and panoramic views, with bold architecture and modern design.
facts.excerpt: This luxury Aspen Mountain hotel offers mountainside access to coveted slopes and stunning panoramic views, paired with bold architecture and modern design.

facts.text: Year-round activities range from skiing in winter to paragliding, rock climbing and rafting in summer.
facts.excerpt: to paragliding, rock climbing, and rafting in summer

facts.text: The property is moments from high-end shopping, museums, galleries and music venues.
facts.excerpt: just moments from high-end shopping, museums, galleries, and music venues

facts.text: Residence guests have their own private rooftop deck as well as access to the public WET Deck.
facts.excerpt: Not only can you access the public WET Deck, you can soak it in on your own private rooftop deck

facts.text: The private rooftop deck has a hot tub, fire pit, BBQ grill and 360-degree mountain views.
facts.excerpt: completed with a hot tub, fire pit, BBQ grill and 360 mountain views

facts.text: The residences feature modern takes on Ute Native American patterns, references to silver mining and furniture inspired by the 1970s.
facts.excerpt: Our Residences feature modern takes on Ute Native American patterns, references to silver mining, furniture inspired by the louche decadence of the 70

facts.text: Each residence has an open floor plan with hardwood flooring and a floating vanity in each bathroom.
facts.excerpt: Open floor plans can be explored in each residence with hardwood flooring and silver touches including a floating vanity in each bathroom

facts.text: The suspended DJ booth takes its cue from the largest silver nugget discovered in Aspen at the turn of the century.
facts.excerpt: Our iconic suspended DJ booth takes its cue from the largest silver nugget discovered in Aspen at the turn of the century.

facts.text: Guests can book the culinary team for private chef dining in their residence.
facts.excerpt: Book our culinary team to experience private dining in Aspen, CO, during your stay in the residential unit.

facts.text: Hidalgo is a speakeasy-inspired agave cocktail lounge and tequileria.
facts.excerpt: This speakeasy-inspired escape blends curated music, vibrant energy, and a sophisticated setting for memorable nights.

facts.text: The Whatever/Whenever service handles guest requests.
facts.excerpt: Your wish is our command with our Whatever/Whenever® service.

facts.text: Guest services include taking a spin in a BMW X7 or X5 and overnight ski storage.
facts.excerpt: From taking a spin in a BMW X7 + X5, storing your skis overnight

facts.text: Dogs are welcome and get a W-branded pet bed.
facts.excerpt: Dogs are welcome at The Sky Residences at W Aspen. Treat your dog to a restful nap on a W-branded pet bed

facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes, a TRX system and boxing equipment.
facts.excerpt: Peloton Bikes, TRX System, Foam Rollers, Yoga Mats, Boxing

Aspen-Pitkin County Airport is about 4 miles from the hotel.
